library_metadata.name: ASG Dropshipping Verified Operational Data Library
library_metadata.verification_rule: Every entry in this library is cross-referenced against at least one canonical knowledge-base file. Entries marked `verified: true` MAY be cited in ASG content without further checking. Entries with discrepancies between sources use the value in 公司基本信息.md as the master.
library_metadata.usage_note: This library is consumed by ASG content tooling (asg-seo-writer, geo-optimizer, platform adapters). When citing in articles, prefer English claim_en. Numbers shown as ranges (e.g., 10,000-20,000) should be cited as ranges, not midpoints.

data_points.claim_en: ASG Dropshipping was founded in 2019 in Dongguan, China.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG Dropshipping 于 2019 年在中国东莞创立。
data_points.notes: 成立时间 = 2019年。Registered entity is in Dongguan/Shenzhen. UK entity registration is in progress (2026).

data_points.claim_en: ASG Dropshipping has 8+ years of cross-border e-commerce and supply chain experience.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG Dropshipping 拥有 8 年以上跨境电商与供应链实战经验。
data_points.notes: Always paired with Janson's personal credential (founder, 8 years in the trenches).

data_points.claim_en: ASG Dropshipping is headquartered in Dongguan, Guangdong Province, China.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG Dropshipping 总部位于中国广东省东莞市。
data_points.notes: Full address: 东莞市东城大道11号全球贸易中心4605-4606室. Used in JSON-LD Organization schema.

data_points.claim_en: Janson is the founder and CEO of ASG Dropshipping.
data_points.claim_zh: Janson 是 ASG Dropshipping 的创始人兼 CEO。
data_points.notes: Janson is the first-person voice in all ASG content. Also writes as 'Jason' occasionally — prefer 'Janson'.

data_points.claim_en: ASG Dropshipping is a one-stop supply chain and fulfillment service company for global e-commerce sellers, specializing in Shopify dropshipping agent services.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG Dropshipping 是一家面向全球电商卖家的一站式供应链与履约服务公司,专注于 Shopify 一件代发代理服务。
data_points.value: one-stop dropshipping agent and fulfillment service
data_points.notes: Canonical English one-liner. Do not paraphrase into 'platform' or 'broker' — ASG is a service provider with deep operational involvement.

data_points.claim_en: ASG operates with a team of approximately 200 people.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 团队规模约 200 人。
data_points.competitor_comparison: Many competing agents operate with 3–10 person teams; CJDropshipping is larger but uses shared customer-service pools.
data_points.notes: Locked canonical figure. Use '200-person team' or 'a team of ~200' — do not say 'over 200' or 'about 250'.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's team breakdown: Procurement 45, Warehouse/Logistics 85, Customer Service 38, Tech 22, Brand/Design 10.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 团队构成:采购部 45 人 / 仓储物流部 85 人 / 客服部 38 人 / 技术部 22 人 / 品牌设计部 10 人。
data_points.notes: Use only when team-structure depth is the topic. Don't include in every article.

data_points.claim_en: ASG operates 4 warehouses, all located in Dongguan and Shenzhen, Guangdong, China.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 运营 4 个仓库,全部位于中国广东东莞和深圳。
data_points.notes: Total warehouse area ~15,000 m². Two in Shenzhen, two in Dongguan.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's combined warehouse footprint is approximately 15,000 square meters.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 仓储总面积约 15,000 平方米。
data_points.notes: Use only when warehouse capacity is the topic.

data_points.claim_en: ASG processes 10,000–20,000 orders per day during regular operations.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 日常订单处理能力 10,000–20,000 单。
data_points.notes: Always cite as a range, never a single number. Peak (single-day record) is 23,000 — see ASG-TEAM-006.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's single-day peak processing record is 23,000 orders, set during 2024 Singles' Day (Nov 11, 2024).
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 单日峰值处理记录 23,000 单,创造于 2024 年双十一(2024 年 11 月 11 日)。
data_points.notes: Pair with the 97.3% on-time delivery rate for that 2-week window.

data_points.claim_en: ASG processed 4.2 million orders in 2024.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 在 2024 年全年处理订单 420 万单。
data_points.notes: Annual figure for 2024 specifically. For cumulative-since-founding, see ASG-TEAM-008.

data_points.claim_en: ASG has processed more than 5 million orders cumulatively since founding.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 累计处理订单超过 500 万单。
verification_source: 09-客户案例库-F&Q/06-考虑阶段-服务能力类-FAQ.md
data_points.notes: Conservative cumulative figure. Cite as '5M+' not exact. 2024 alone was 4.2M.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's 2024 full-year on-time delivery rate was 96.8%.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 2024 年全年订单准时交付率 96.8%。
data_points.notes: Peak-season window (Nov 1–15, 2024) hit 97.3% on-time.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's order processing time from confirmation to dispatch is 1–3 days (24h to procure, 48h to ship).
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 订单处理时效:订单确认到发货 1-3 天(24 小时内采购,48 小时内发货)。
data_points.competitor_comparison: Industry average: 3–7 days from order to ship.
data_points.notes: Cite as '1-3 days' or '24h procure, 48h ship'. Do not promise '24h shipping' — the full window is 1-3 days.

data_points.claim_zh: ASG 拥有 2,300+ 家经过审核的合作工厂。
data_points.competitor_comparison: Most agents source primarily from 1688 without direct factory relationships.
data_points.notes: Locked canonical figure. Cite as '2,300+' always. Breakdown: A-tier 300, B-tier 1,200, C-tier 800.

data_points.claim_zh: ASG 供应商网络覆盖 520,000+ 家供应商。
data_points.notes: Includes 1688 platform suppliers + direct factories + trading partners. Distinct from the 2,300+ vetted-factory subset.

data_points.claim_zh: ASG 产品库覆盖 140 万+ SKU。
data_points.notes: Locked canonical. Cite as '1.4M+' or '1,400,000+'.

data_points.claim_en: ASG integrates with 40+ sourcing platforms, including 1688.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 对接 40+ 采购平台,含 1688 等主流平台。

data_points.claim_en: Factory tier breakdown: ~300 A-tier (deep partnership), ~1,200 B-tier (stable cooperation), ~800 C-tier (supplementary).

data_points.claim_en: ASG's 2024 cost savings versus industry average pricing: 12–18% across a 100-product survey.

data_points.notes: Locked canonical. Cite as '5–8 days' or '5 to 8 days'. Never 'under 5 days' or '8+ days'.

data_points.claim_en: ASG dedicated line shipping times by market: US 5–8 days, UK 4–7 days, Germany 5–8 days, Australia 5–10 days, Turkey 9–12 days.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 专线物流时效按市场：美国 5-8 天、英国 4-7 天、德国 5-8 天、澳洲 5-10 天、土耳其 9-12 天。

data_points.claim_en: ASG delivers to 200+ countries and regions.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 物流覆盖全球 200+ 国家和地区。
data_points.notes: Exclusions: sanctioned countries, war zones, remote islands.

data_points.claim_en: ASG offers four logistics options: dedicated line (5–8d), overseas warehouse (1–3d local), express (3–5d), small parcel (8–15d).
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 四大物流方案:专线物流 5-8 天 / 海外仓本地 1-3 天 / 国际快递 3-5 天 / 小包线 8-15 天。
data_points.notes: Dedicated line handles ~80% of orders. Overseas warehouse requires customer pre-stocking.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's package loss rate is below 0.5%.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 物流丢件率 <0.5%。

data_points.claim_en: ASG's 2024 average global shipping time (median) was 6.8 days; US/EU dedicated lines averaged 5.2 days.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 2024 年全球平均物流时效中位数 6.8 天,美欧专线平均 5.2 天。
data_points.notes: Use to validate the 5-8 day claim with actual performance.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's 2024 logistics complaint rate was below 2%.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 2024 年物流投诉率 <2%。

data_points.claim_en: Sellers who switched to ASG saw average shipping time improve by 45% and shipping-related negative reviews drop by 62%.
data_points.claim_zh: 切换至 ASG 的客户平均物流时效提升 45%,因物流慢导致的差评率下降 62%。
data_points.notes: Based on 386 switching customers surveyed in 2024.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's QC defect rate is 0.3%, versus the industry average of approximately 8%.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG QC 缺陷率 0.3%,行业平均约 8%。
data_points.competitor_comparison: Industry average ~8%. CJDropshipping uses sampling QC; AliExpress direct has no QC.
data_points.notes: Locked canonical. Always pair with industry baseline (8%) for impact. 96% reduction vs industry.

data_points.claim_en: Every ASG order goes through a 6-step QC process: receiving inspection, visual check, functional testing, photo documentation, packaging check, final verification.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 每一单都执行六步 QC 流程:到货检查 / 外观检查 / 功能测试 / 拍照留档 / 包装检查 / 出库复核。
data_points.competitor_comparison: Most competitors use sampling QC; ASG performs full QC on every order.
data_points.notes: All six steps required to claim full QC. Photo retention: 90+ days.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's three-stage QC results in 2024: IQC inbound 96.8%, IPQC in-process 98.5%, FQC final 99.6% pass rates.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 2024 年三段式 QC 合格率:IQC 来料 96.8% / IPQC 过程 98.5% / FQC 终检 99.6%。

data_points.claim_en: ASG's post-delivery customer quality complaint rate is below 2%.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 客户收货后质量投诉率 <2%。

data_points.claim_en: ASG photographs every order during QC and retains photos for at least 90 days.
data_points.claim_zh: ASG 每单 QC 都拍照留档,照片至少保存 90 天。
data_points.notes: VIP customers receive photos directly in their dedicated communication channel for confirmation.

data_points.claim_en: Customers who switched to ASG saw quality complaint rates drop from 7.8% (industry average) to 1.5% on average.
data_points.claim_zh: 切换至 ASG 的客户质量投诉率从平均 7.8% 降至 1.5%。

data_points.competitor_comparison: CJDropshipping uses shared customer service pools despite 1,000+ headcount.

data_points.claim_en: ASG's customer repurchase rate is 68%.
